reason: A Cordis plugin that integrates QQ Bot messaging with DeepSeek Harness agents, supporting QQ message routing, LLM replies, per-conversation sessions, model selection, and credential setup.

summaries.zh: 将 QQ Bot 消息接入 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，支持私聊和群聊会话、模型切换及 Markdown 回复。
summaries.en: Connects QQ Bot conversations to DeepSeek Harness agents with private and group sessions, model switching, and Markdown replies.

capabilities: Connects to QQ Bot through WebSocket
Receives QQ private and group messages
Sends Markdown responses to QQ conversations
Routes messages to dsh agents and configured LLM models
Maintains persistent per-peer sessions and preferences
Stores QQ Bot credentials in the dsh profile
